The camera quickly pans up to reveal two female cheerleaders standing in a hallway. They are wearing white pleated skirts and matching baseball jerseys with the text 'MONKEYS' and the Rakuten logo. Both women have their hair down and are smiling at the camera. (2) The women begin a synchronized dance routine. They move their arms in a series of sharp, rhythmic motions, crossing their hands in front of their chests and then extending them outward. The woman on the left has long black hair and the woman on the right wears a red baseball cap. The corridor background features maroon walls with white 'Rakuten' branding and exposed silver pipes on the ceiling. (3) As the dance continues, the performers incorporate leg kicks and high-fives into their choreography. Their facial expressions remain highly animated and cheerful, maintaining direct eye contact with the lens. They perform a series of jumps and spins, with their skirts fluttering as they move. (4) The final phase shows them pointing toward the camera and striking a celebratory pose with one arm raised high. The lighting remains consistent and even throughout the indoor stadium hallway.
